summary: Specifies the Voucher Trading System Application Programming Interface (VTS-API). It lets a wallet or other application issue, transfer and redeem vouchers uniformly, independent of the underlying VTS implementation. It is informational.

eli5.summary: This is a set of buttons for a digital wallet: give out a coupon, hand one to a friend, or use one. The buttons look the same no matter how the machine behind them works.

questions: how to issue and redeem vouchers
